name: RAYVN log -> Bridge log
info: Converts Rayvn log entries to Bridge format. Extracts id, text, timeCreated, loggedByFullName and adds client identifier.

name: map rayvn log to bridge log
info:
This function takes an array of rayvn log entries
and transforms them into the format of bridge entries
(standardised format for logentries in Parat-Bridge)
